cn: 结婚；婚姻生活；密切结合，合并

example.cn: 她前一次婚姻生了三个女儿。

cn: 映射；计划；绘制地图；确定基因在染色体中的位置
enDef: to make a map of a particular area

example.en: He spent the next fifteen years mapping the Isle of Anglesey.
example.cn: 他在后来的十五年里绘制了安格尔西岛的地图。

enDef: the round object that you can see shining in the sky at night, and that moves around the Earth every 28 days

example.cn: 月球表面的环形山

enDef: an event, situation etc that people do not understand or cannot explain because they do not know enough about it

example.en: Twenty years after the event, his death remains a mystery .
example.cn: 事情过去二十年了，他的死仍然是个谜。

cn: 监视器；监听器；监控器；显示屏；班长
enDef: a television or part of a computer with a screen, on which you can see pictures or information

example.cn: 心脏监测仪

enDef: belonging to the present time or most recent time

example.cn: 此类公司如果想在现代社会中与别人竞争，就必须有所改变。

enDef: of middle size, level, or amount

example.en: What size shirt does he wear – small, medium or large?
example.cn: 他穿多大尺码的衬衫——小号、中号还是大号？

enDef: a large thin book with a paper cover that contains news stories, articles, photographs etc, and is sold weekly or monthly

example.en: a magazine article
example.cn: 杂志中的文章

enDef: to direct or control a business or department and the people, equipment, and money involved in it

example.en: He was asked to manage a new department.
example.cn: 他被要求去管理一个新的部门。

enDef: the number

example.en: The book sold more than a million copies.
example.cn: 这本书售出了一百多万册。

enDef: to be important, especially to be important to you, or to have an effect on what happens

example.en: If I have to stay late at work tonight, it won’t matter because we can go out another night.
example.cn: 如果今晚我必须工作到很晚的话，那也没关系，我们可以改天晚上再出去。

cn: 母亲；大娘；女修道院院长
enDef: a female parent of a child or animal

example.en: His mother and father are both doctors.
example.cn: 他的父母都是医生。

cn: 疯狂的；发疯的；愚蠢的；着迷的
enDef: crazy or very silly

example.en: He can’t possibly get that finished in time. He must be mad !
example.cn: 他不可能按时完成的。他一定是疯了！

enDef: mathematics

example.en: Tim’s good at math and science.
example.cn: 蒂姆的数学和自然科学很好。

enDef: the way in which something is done or happens

example.en: He felt some guilt over the manner of her death.
example.cn: 她以这种方式死去，他心里有些内疚。

enDef: the third month of the year, between February and April

example.en: I flew to Milwaukee in early March.
example.cn: 我3月初飞到了密尔沃基。

enDef: if you marry someone, you become their husband or wife

example.en: He married Bea in 1925.
example.cn: 他在1925年娶了贝亚。

cn: 会议， 集会； 会合， 相会； 运动会
enDef: an event at which people meet to discuss and decide things

example.en: We’re having a meeting next week to discuss the matter.
example.cn: 我们下周将开会讨论此事。

enDef: the letters and packages that are delivered to you

example.en: You shouldn’t read other people’s mail.
example.cn: 你不应该看别人的信件。

enDef: Mr. is used before a man's name when you are speaking or referring to him

example.en: ...Mr. Grant.
example.cn: …格兰特先生。

enDef: relating to medicine and the treatment of disease or injury

example.en: medical research
example.cn: 医学研究

cn: 矿，矿藏；矿山，矿井；地雷，水雷
enDef: to dig large holes in the ground in order to remove coal, gold etc

example.en: They learnt how to lay mines (= put them in place ) .
example.cn: 他们学习了如何布雷。

cn: 马拉松长跑； 持久比赛； 〈喻〉拖时长久令人
enDef: a long race of about 26 miles or 42 kilometres

example.en: the Boston Marathon
example.cn: 波士顿马拉松赛

cn: 记忆； 回忆； 纪念； 存储
enDef: something that you remember from the past about a person, place, or experience

example.en: He has lots of happy memories of his stay in Japan.
example.cn: 他对在日本逗留的那段时光有许多美好的回忆。

enDef: having the greatest amount of a particular quality

example.en: She’s one of the most experienced teachers in the district.
example.cn: 她是该地区最有经验的教师之一。

enDef: to kill someone deliberately and illegally

example.en: He was convicted of murdering a policeman.
example.cn: 他被判谋杀一名警察的罪名成立。

cn: 必须，一定；可以，应当；很可能
enDef: the newly pressed juice of grapes or other fruit ready for fermentation

example.en: Warm clothes are a must in the mountains.
example.cn: 御寒衣物在山里是必不可少的。

cn: 我自己； 我亲自， 我本人
enDef: used by the person speaking or writing to show that they are affected by their own action

example.en: I blame myself for what has happened.
example.cn: 发生这一切都怪我自己。

cn: 女士，小姐，年轻未婚女子
enDef: used in front of the family name of a woman who is not married to address her politely, to write to her, or to talk about her

example.en: I’d like to make an appointment with Miss Taylor.
example.cn: 我想约一下泰勒小姐。

cn: 机械，机器；机构；机械般工作的人
enDef: a piece of equipment with moving parts that uses power such as electricity to do a particular job

example.en: Could you get me a coffee from the drinks machine ?
example.cn: 给我从自动饮料机里买一罐咖啡好吗？

enDef: an occasion when you eat food, for example breakfast or dinner, or the food that you eat on that occasion

example.en: We must have a meal together some time.
example.cn: 我们一定要找个时间一起吃顿饭。

enDef: having very serious or worrying results

example.en: There is a major problem with parking in London.
example.cn: 在伦敦，停车是个很大的问题。

enDef: when someone moves for a short time in a particular direction

example.en: Good gymnasts rehearse their moves mentally before a competition.
example.cn: 优秀的体操运动员赛前都会在心中默默地把动作过一遍。

enDef: the early part of the day, from when the sun rises until 12 o’clock in the middle of the day

example.en: I hated those cold winter mornings.
example.cn: 我讨厌冬天里寒冷的早晨。

cn: [meant-meant] 表示…的意思； 意欲， 打算； 意指， 意味着
enDef: to have or represent a particular meaning

example.en: What does ‘patronizing’ mean?
example.cn: patronizing是什么意思？

example.en: I gave up eating meat a few months ago.
example.cn: 我几个月以前开始不吃肉了。

cn: 主要部分，要点；体力；总管道

example.en: The heater will run off mains gas or bottled gas.
example.cn: 热水器使用管道煤气或罐装煤气均可。

enDef: a planned way of doing something, especially one that a lot of people know about and use

example.en: traditional teaching methods
example.cn: 传统的教学法

cn: 谦虚的， 谨慎的； 适度的
enDef: someone who is modest does not want to talk about their abilities or achievements

example.cn: 你太谦虚了！你帮了我们大忙呢。

enDef: a unit for measuring distance, equal to 1,760  yard s  or about 1,609 metres

example.cn: 从这里到波兰边界有40英里。

enDef: to take milk from a cow or goat

example.en: I helped to milk the cows.
example.cn: 我帮忙挤牛奶。

enDef: the day between Sunday and Tuesday

example.en: The president announced Monday that he would cancel the debt.
example.cn: 总统周一宣布他会取消这笔债务。

cn: 反映； 反射， 映照
enDef: If something mirrors something else, it has similar features to it, and therefore seems like a copy or representation of it

example.en: Despite the fact that I have tried to be objective, the book inevitably mirrors my own interests and experiences.
example.cn: 尽管我曾努力做到客观，但这本书还是不可避免地反映出了我自己的兴趣和经历。

enDef: used when you are surprised,  impress ed  ,or upset

example.en: All my friends do not smoke.
example.cn: 我的朋友并不全都吸烟。

cn: 头脑， 精神， 理智； 智力； 注意力， 心思； 意向， 想法
enDef: your thoughts or your ability to think, feel, and imagine things

example.en: It is impossible to understand the complex nature of the human mind .
example.cn: 要想了解人类思维复杂的特性是不可能的。

enDef: a film made to be shown at the cinema or on television

example.en: It was like one of those old John Wayne movies.
example.cn: 这部电影有点像约翰•韦恩演的一部老片子。

cn: [met-met] 遇见， 碰到； 接； 和…见面， 和…会面
enDef: to go to a place where someone will be at a particular time, according to an arrangement, so that you can talk or do something together

example.en: Meet me at 8.00.
example.cn: 八点钟来见我。

enDef: used to say that something may happen or may be true but you are not certain

example.en: Maybe it’s all just a big misunderstanding.
example.cn: 也许这只是一个很大的误会。

cn: 令人误解的， 导致错误结论的； 引入歧途的； 欺骗的； 迷惑人的
enDef: likely to make someone believe something that is not true

example.en: The article was misleading, and the newspaper has apologized.
example.cn: 那篇文章具有误导性，那家报纸已致歉。

cn: 物质的， 实际的； 客观存在的； 重要的
enDef: relating to the real world and physical objects, rather than religious or  spiritual  things

example.en: According to some, the material world is all that exists.
example.cn: 有些人认为，物质世界就是存在的一切。

enDef: to talk or write about something or someone, usually quickly and without saying very much or giving details

example.en: Was my name mentioned at all?
example.cn: 我的名字被提到过吗？

enDef: a person or country that belongs to a group or organization

example.en: The majority of union members voted in favour of a strike.
example.cn: 大多数工会成员投票赞成罢工。

enDef: an adult male human

example.en: There were two men and a woman in the car.
example.cn: 车上有两男一女。

enDef: if something may happen or may be true, there is a possibility that it will happen or be true but this is not certain

example.en: I may be late, so don’t wait for me.
example.cn: 我可能会迟到，所以别等我。

enDef: a list of all the kinds of food that are available for a meal, especially in a restaurant

example.en: Could we have the menu, please?
example.cn: 请把菜单给我们，好吗？

cn: 修理， 修补； 改良， 改进； 修正， 改正； 恢复健康， 痊愈
enDef: if a broken bone mends, it becomes whole again

example.en: His leg isn’t mending as quickly as he’d expected.
example.cn: 他的腿愈合得不像他预想的那样快。

cn: 凌乱的状态， 脏乱的状态； 混乱的局面， 困
enDef: if there is a mess somewhere or a place is a mess, things there are dirty or not neatly arranged

example.en: What a mess!
example.cn: 太乱了！

enDef: to produce something, for example by putting the different parts of it together

example.en: I’m going to show you how to make a box for your tools.
example.cn: 我来教你怎么做一个箱子存放工具。

enDef: a type of  oven  that cooks food very quickly using very short electric waves instead of heat

example.en: I’ll heat it up in the microwave.
example.cn: 我来把它用微波炉热一热。

enDef: to learn a skill or a language so well that you have no difficulty with it

example.en: the skills needed to master a new language
example.cn: 掌握一门新语言所需的技能

cn: 意思， 含义； 意义
enDef: the thing or idea that a word, expression, or sign represents

example.en: What’s the meaning of this? I asked you to be here an hour ago!
example.cn: 这是什么意思？我让你一小时之前就要到的！

enDef: used to address a woman in a polite way, especially a customer in a shop

example.en: Are you being served, Madam?
example.cn: 有人接待您吗，夫人？

enDef: a large area where there are a lot of shops, usually a covered area where cars are not allowed

example.en: Let’s meet at the mall and go see a movie.
example.cn: 我们在购物中心碰头，然后去看电影吧。

enDef: the power to make impossible things happen by saying special words or doing special actions

example.en: Do you believe in magic?
example.cn: 你相信魔法吗？

enDef: someone whose job is to manage part or all of a company or other organization

example.en: one of our regional managers
example.cn: 我们的一位地区经理

cn: 标志；马克；符号；痕迹；分数
enDef: a cut, hole, or other small sign of damage

example.en: I can’t get these marks out of my T-shirt.
example.cn: 我无法把我T恤衫上的这些污迹去掉。

cn: 市场；行情；股票市场；市面；集市；销路；商店
enDef: a particular country or area where a company sells its goods or where a particular type of goods is sold

example.en: Our main overseas market is Japan.
example.cn: 我们的主要海外市场是日本。

example.cn: 我们把柜子刷成绿色，和地毯相配。

enDef: used by the person speaking or writing to refer to himself or herself

example.en: Stop, you’re hurting me.
example.cn: 住手，你弄疼我了。

cn: 模型；典型；模范；模特儿；样式
enDef: a small copy of a building, vehicle, machine etc, especially one that can be put together from separate parts

example.en: a working model (= one with parts which move ) of a steam engine
example.cn: 蒸汽机车的活动模型

enDef: a substance used for treating illness, especially a liquid you drink

example.en: Medicines should be kept out of the reach of children.
example.cn: 药应放在孩子够不到的地方。

enDef: if you mix two or more substances or if they mix, they combine to become a single substance, and they cannot be easily separated

example.en: Oil and water don’t mix.
example.cn: 油和水不相融。

enDef: nearest the centre and furthest from the edge, top, end etc

example.en: driving in the middle lane of the motorway
example.cn: 在高速公路的中间车道上行驶

cn: 消息；差使；启示；预言；广告词
enDef: a spoken or written piece of information that you send to another person or leave for them

example.en: He left a message saying he would probably be a little late.
example.cn: 他留言说可能会晚一点来。

enDef: a hard, usually shiny substance such as iron, gold, or steel

example.en: The gate is made of metal.
example.cn: 这扇大门是用金属做成的。

enDef: The many means a large group of people, especially the ordinary people in society, considered as separate from a particular small group

example.en: The printing press gave power to a few to change the world for the many.
example.cn: 印刷机赋予了少数人为多数人改变世界的力量。

cn: 分，分钟；片刻，一会儿；备忘录，笔记；会议记录

example.en: It takes me ten minutes to walk to work.
example.cn: 我步行上班要用十分钟。

cn: 片刻，瞬间，时刻；重要，契机
enDef: a particular point in time

example.en: It was one of the most exciting moments in his life.
example.cn: 这是他一生中最激动人心的时刻之一。

enDef: what you earn by working and can use to buy things. Money can be in the form of notes and coins or cheques, and can be kept in a bank

example.en: Don’t spend all your money on the first day of your holiday!
example.cn: 别在度假的第一天就把钱都花完了！

enDef: a small brown animal with a long tail, which uses its hands to climb trees and lives in hot countries

example.en: Stop that, you little monkey!
example.cn: 别这样，你这个小淘气鬼！

enDef: one of the 12 named periods of time that a year is divided into

example.en: I hope I’ll have finished the work by the end of the month .
example.cn: 我希望我这个月底能完成工作。

enDef: a fast two-wheeled vehicle with an engine

example.en: You'd better encash your motorcycle at once.
example.cn: 你最好马上卖掉摩托车换成现款。

enDef: a very high hill

example.en: the highest mountain in Austria
example.cn: 奥地利最高的山

enDef: the part of your face which you put food into, or which you use for speaking

example.en: He lifted his glass to his mouth.
example.cn: 他把玻璃杯举到嘴边。

enDef: a building where important  cultural  , historical, or scientific objects are kept and shown to the public

example.en: the Museum of Modern Art
example.cn: 现代艺术博物馆

enDef: a series of sounds made by instruments or voices in a way that is pleasant or exciting

example.en: I often listen to classic music when I’m in the car.
example.cn: 我在车上经常听古典音乐。

enDef: by a great amount

example.en: Then you can have much in common with them.
example.cn: 然后你可以与他们有许多共同之处。

cn: 鼠； 胆小的人； 鼠标
enDef: a small object connected to a computer by a wire, which you move with your hand to give instructions to the computer

example.en: Select the printer icon and then click the left mouse button.
example.cn: 选择打印机图标，然后点击鼠标左键。

enDef: a flat piece of metal, usually shaped like a coin, that is given to someone who has won a competition or who has done something brave

example.en: She won a gold medal at the last Olympics.
example.cn: 她在上届奥运会上赢得一枚金牌。

enDef: something that has been done in the wrong way, or an opinion or statement that is incorrect

example.en: The most common mistake is to plant them too deep.
example.cn: 最常见的错误就是把它们种得太深了。

enDef: having a particular quality to a greater degree

example.en: You’ll have to be more careful next time.
example.cn: 你下次要更小心一点。

enDef: mother

example.en: Mom, can I go over to Lisa’s house?
example.cn: 妈妈，我能到莉萨家去吗？

cn: 可以〔用于礼貌地提出建议〕
enDef: used to suggest politely what someone should do

example.en: If you need more information, you might try the Internet.
example.cn: 如果你需要更多的信息，可以试试因特网。

enDef: the small red  planet  that is fourth in order from the Sun and is nearest the Earth

example.en: the enormous volcanoes known to exist on Mars
example.cn: 已知在火星上存在的大量火山

cn: 神秘的， 难以理解的
enDef: mysterious events or situations are difficult to explain or understand

example.en: The police are investigating the mysterious deaths of children at the hospital.
example.cn: 警察正在调查这家医院的儿童神秘死亡事件。

enDef: mathematics

example.en: the new maths teacher
example.cn: 新来的数学老师

example.en: The iris of the eye is photographed from up to one meter away.
example.cn: 眼睛的虹膜最远可在一公尺外的距离接受摄影。

enDef: someone who plays a musical instrument, especially very well or as a job

example.en: a talented young musician
example.cn: 有天赋的年轻音乐家

enDef: unusually large

example.en: a monster cat
example.cn: 巨型猫

enDef: while something else is happening

example.cn: 用中火把调味汁煮到变稠，同时烧水准备煮意大利面。

enDef: something that covers all or part of your face, to protect or to hide it

example.en: a surgical face mask
example.cn: 外科手术口罩

enDef: relating to the health or state of someone’s mind

example.en: The centre provides help for people suffering from mental illness .
example.cn: 该中心对精神病患者提供帮助。

enDef: being kind to people and forgiving them rather than punishing them or being cruel

example.en: Merciful God, save us.
example.cn: 仁慈的上帝，救救我们吧。

enDef: to increase by a large amount or number, or to make something do this

example.en: The amount of information available has multiplied.
example.cn: 可获得的信息大大增加了。

enDef: not fixed in one position, and easy to move and use in different places

example.en: mobile air-conditioners
example.cn: 移动式空调器

enDef: relating to music or consisting of music

example.en: a musical version of the fairy tale ‘Cinderella’
example.cn: 童话故事《灰姑娘》的音乐剧版

enDef: someone who is very rich and has at least a million pounds or dollars

example.en: an American millionaire
example.cn: 一位美国百万富翁

cn: 纪念碑，纪念馆；纪念仪式；纪念物
enDef: something, especially a stone with writing on it, that reminds people of someone who has died

example.en: Building a memorial to Columbus has been his lifelong dream.
example.cn: 建一座哥伦布纪念碑一直是他一生的梦想。

enDef: used to show that one number or quantity is being  subtract ed  from another
a substance that is formed naturally in the earth, such as coal, salt, stone, or gold. Minerals can be dug out of the ground and used

example.en: The area is very rich in minerals .
example.cn: 该地区矿产非常丰富。

enDef: mother – used by or to young children

example.en: Be very good and very quiet and help your mommy.
example.cn: 你要乖乖的，安静些，要帮妈咪。

enDef: relating to Mexico or its people

example.en: the Mexican government
example.cn: 墨西哥政府

enDef: a piece of electronic equipment that allows information from one computer to be sent along telephone wires to another computer

example.en: He sent his work to his publishers by modem.
example.cn: 他通过调制解调器把作品发给他的出版商。

enDef: to fail to understand someone or something correctly

example.cn: 雷切尔，你一定是误会她了！埃莉绝不会说那样的话。

example.cn: 对三个月内的降雨量进行了测量。

example.en: Jack is an intelligent pupil, but he lacks motivation.
example.cn: 杰克是一个很聪明的学生，但学习不够主动。
